tools.name: noinfra.email.provision
tools.description: Get a dedicated NoInfra email inbox for an agent running anywhere. Your NoInfra account owner must authorize access first. Reuse the same idempotency key when retrying.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: noinfra.email.provision · Public sink: noinfra.email.provision.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: noinfra.email.provision · Public sink: noinfra.email.provision

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
